decisions.reason: It fits the firm's modular environmental-sensing platform well and likely retains demand, although overlap with other air-monitoring options makes it somewhat less secure than core modules.
As a current-generation replacement for an older voltage measurement module, it is a basic platform function that supports many embedded and measurement use cases.
CAN connectivity matches the firm's automation and industrial customer base, so it remains strategically useful even if demand is more specialized.
A CO2 sensor module is strongly aligned with schools, companies, and building-monitoring applications and is a natural complement to the firm's sensing portfolio.
